full_name: Rebecca Mercuri | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
bio: Rebecca Mercuri, a computer scientist and founder of the consulting firm Notable Software, Inc., is a specialist in digital real-time systems, computer security, and computer public policy.
